text: {"lessons":["I should avoid reacting to one month’s price swings; my decision not to trade through the early fluctuations kept me from making impulsive changes.","Selling Stock D at a gain felt satisfying, but I should base future sales on my goals and portfolio risk, not just the pleasure of locking in a profit.","A winning sale does not remove the pain of an overall decline; I should diversify and review my holdings periodically while keeping losses and risk in perspective."]}
